text:
Sasha: Hey everyone — personal announcement: Lisa said YES 🎉💍 We're engaged!! Probably have to change my calendar to 'fiancé mode' 😅
Priya: OMG congrats Sasha!! :tada: so happy for you two — when's the celebration?
Marco: Huge congrats!! When's the ring photo drop? :camera_with_flash:
Sasha: Photo incoming... later. Quick Q: thinking of doing a small office celebration next Friday at 3pm. Want to do snacks — what should I bring? Vote with emoji: :cake: = cake, :taco: = tacos, :sushi: = sushi platter, :donut: = donuts
Jen: :cake: definitely cake. @Sasha when's the RSVP?
Evan: :taco: for sure. also congrats!!
Olive: :sushi: but also cake?
Noor: Congrats!! sending confetti :confetti_ball: (reaction: :heart: x4)
Sasha: RSVP by Wednesday pls. If you can't make it but want to send a note, DM me. Also open to gift/no-gift friends. ❤️
Marco: RSVP yes. cake works for me — but I'll bring a tiny speaker for vibes.
Priya: Count me in! :cake: 
Jen: Me too — bringing party napkins. :party-popper: 
celebration-bot: Reminder set for Friday 3pm — “Sasha & Lisa engagement celebration” (reminder id: 5221)
Sasha: Thanks y'all — love you guys. Pics on Monday promise. :smiling_face_with_three_hearts:
